problems: slide 5: "Wartime scraps built a furniture giant" is not supported by SOURCE. SOURCE doesn't say tent pegs from scraps built the company or that Ercol became a 'giant'; Ercol was founded in 1920, so remove or rephrase.

caption: "In 1944 the company was asked to make 100,000 low-cost Windsor chairs from elm" is not supported by SOURCE. SOURCE says the chairs used steam bending of English elm, so the elm and 100,000 chairs are supported, but 'asked' loosely fits; actually acceptable—however the elm warping and drying link is supported, so this is fine.
